examples.hanzi: 你别急,一下子说这么多我记不住。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié jí, yīxiàzi shuō zhème duō wǒ jì bú zhù.
examples.english: Don't rush, I can't remember it if you say so much all at once.

examples.hanzi: 窗外一下子下起了大雨。
examples.pinyin: Chuāng wài yīxiàzi xiàqǐle dàyǔ.
examples.english: Suddenly it started pouring outside the window.

examples.hanzi: 我从小就喜欢写作,梦想当作家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù xǐhuan xiězuò, mèngxiǎng dāng zuòjiā.
examples.english: I've loved writing since I was little and dream of becoming an author.

examples.hanzi: 这门写作课每周有一次作业。
examples.pinyin: Zhè mén xiězuò kè měi zhōu yǒu yí cì zuòyè.
examples.english: This writing course has an assignment every week.

examples.hanzi: 这个密码已经无效了,请重新设置。
examples.pinyin: Zhège mìmǎ yǐjīng wúxiào le, qǐng chóngxīn shèzhì.
examples.english: This password is no longer valid, please set a new one.

examples.hanzi: 我跟他说了半天,结果还是无效。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā shuōle bàntiān, jiéguǒ háishi wúxiào.
examples.english: I talked to him for ages, but it was all in vain.

examples.hanzi: 我和我哥哥有很多共同点。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé wǒ gēge yǒu hěn duō gòngtóngdiǎn.
examples.english: My brother and I have a lot in common.

examples.hanzi: 你们两个人有什么共同点吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen liǎng gè rén yǒu shénme gòngtóngdiǎn ma?
examples.english: Do you two have anything in common?

examples.hanzi: 那座大厦是这个城市最高的建筑。
examples.pinyin: Nà zuò dàshà shì zhège chéngshì zuì gāo de jiànzhù.
examples.english: That tower is the tallest building in this city.

examples.hanzi: 我们公司在市中心的一座大厦里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī zài shì zhōngxīn de yí zuò dàshà lǐ.
examples.english: Our company is in a building in the city center.

examples.hanzi: 今天大家都到了,只有小王是例外。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān dàjiā dōu dào le, zhǐyǒu Xiǎo Wáng shì lìwài.
examples.english: Everyone arrived today, with Xiao Wang being the only exception.

examples.hanzi: 这条规定没有例外,请大家遵守。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo guīdìng méiyǒu lìwài, qǐng dàjiā zūnshǒu.
examples.english: There are no exceptions to this rule, so please follow it.

examples.hanzi: 这部电影的画面太震撼了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de huàmiàn tài zhènhàn le.
examples.english: The visuals in this movie are so stunning.

examples.hanzi: 看到那么大的瀑布,我心里很震撼。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào nàme dà de pùbù, wǒ xīnli hěn zhènhàn.
examples.english: Seeing such a huge waterfall, I was deeply awed.

examples.hanzi: 警察在车上发现了一包海洛因。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zài chē shàng fāxiànle yì bāo hǎiluòyīn.
examples.english: The police found a package of heroin in the car.

examples.hanzi: 海洛因会让人上瘾,毁掉一个人的生活。
examples.pinyin: Hǎiluòyīn huì ràng rén shàngyǐn, huǐdiào yí gè rén de shēnghuó.
examples.english: Heroin is addictive and can ruin a person's life.

examples.hanzi: 他觉得自己长得很丑陋,不敢照镜子。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéde zìjǐ zhǎng de hěn chǒulòu, bù gǎn zhào jìngzi.
examples.english: He thinks he looks ugly and doesn't dare look in the mirror.

examples.hanzi: 这种丑陋的行为让大家很生气。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chǒulòu de xíngwéi ràng dàjiā hěn shēngqì.
examples.english: This ugly behavior made everyone angry.

examples.hanzi: 这首歌打动了很多人的心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē dǎdòngle hěn duō rén de xīn.
examples.english: This song touched many people's hearts.

examples.hanzi: 她的真诚打动了所有的评委。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zhēnchéng dǎdòngle suǒyǒu de píngwěi.
examples.english: Her sincerity won over all the judges.

examples.hanzi: 老师经常赞美学生的努力。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jīngcháng zànměi xuésheng de nǔlì.
examples.english: The teacher often praises the students' efforts.

examples.hanzi: 她的歌声得到了观众的赞美。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gēshēng dédàole guānzhòng de zànměi.
examples.english: Her singing received praise from the audience.

examples.hanzi: 第一回合他就被对手打倒了。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī huíhé tā jiù bèi duìshǒu dǎdǎo le.
examples.english: He was knocked down by his opponent in the very first round.

examples.hanzi: 比赛打了三个回合,还是不分胜负。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài dǎle sān gè huíhé, háishi bù fēn shèngfù.
examples.english: The match went three rounds and it was still undecided.

examples.hanzi: 这顶假发看起来跟真的一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dǐng jiǎfà kàn qǐlái gēn zhēn de yíyàng.
examples.english: This wig looks just like real hair.

examples.hanzi: 他生病以后一直戴着假发。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēngbìng yǐhòu yìzhí dàizhe jiǎfà.
examples.english: He has worn a wig ever since he got sick.

examples.hanzi: 这部电视剧每天晚上八点播出。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànshìjù měitiān wǎnshang bā diǎn bōchū.
examples.english: This TV series airs at eight every evening.

examples.hanzi: 我妈妈最爱看家庭电视剧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma zuì ài kàn jiātíng diànshìjù.
examples.english: My mom loves watching family dramas the most.

examples.hanzi: 她最近在减肥,晚上不吃米饭。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn zài jiǎnféi, wǎnshang bù chī mǐfàn.
examples.english: She's dieting lately and doesn't eat rice at night.

examples.hanzi: 减肥不容易,要多运动少吃零食。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎnféi bù róngyì, yào duō yùndòng shǎo chī língshí.
examples.english: Losing weight isn't easy; you need to exercise more and snack less.

examples.hanzi: 现在才七点,去机场还来得及。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài cái qī diǎn, qù jīchǎng hái láidejí.
examples.english: It's only seven now, so there's still time to get to the airport.

examples.hanzi: 路上不堵车的话,我们来得及吃早饭。
examples.pinyin: Lùshang bù dǔchē dehuà, wǒmen láidejí chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: If there's no traffic, we'll have time to eat breakfast.

examples.hanzi: 我先拿两个,其余的你们分吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiān ná liǎng gè, qíyú de nǐmen fēn ba.
examples.english: I'll take two first, and you can split the rest.

examples.hanzi: 除了小李,其余的同学都到了。
examples.pinyin: Chúle Xiǎo Lǐ, qíyú de tóngxué dōu dào le.
examples.english: Apart from Xiao Li, all the other classmates are here.

examples.hanzi: 没想到我们会走到这种地步。
examples.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào wǒmen huì zǒudào zhè zhǒng dìbù.
examples.english: I never thought we'd end up in this state.

examples.hanzi: 他生气到了不想再说话的地步。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēngqì dàole bù xiǎng zài shuōhuà de dìbù.
examples.english: He was so angry that he didn't want to say another word.

examples.hanzi: 这位警官执法非常公正。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jǐngguān zhífǎ fēicháng gōngzhèng.
examples.english: This officer enforces the law very fairly.

examples.hanzi: 执法人员正在检查每一辆车。
examples.pinyin: Zhífǎ rényuán zhèngzài jiǎnchá měi yí liàng chē.
examples.english: Law enforcement officers are checking every car.

examples.hanzi: 星期一早上我总是特别困。
examples.pinyin: Xīngqīyī zǎoshang wǒ zǒngshì tèbié kùn.
examples.english: I'm always especially sleepy on Monday mornings.

examples.hanzi: 下个星期一是我的生日。
examples.pinyin: Xià gè xīngqīyī shì wǒ de shēngrì.
examples.english: Next Monday is my birthday.

examples.hanzi: 请帮我把这份炒饭打包。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ bǎ zhè fèn chǎofàn dǎbāo.
examples.english: Please pack up this fried rice for me to take away.

examples.hanzi: 明天要出差,我今晚得打包行李。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào chūchāi, wǒ jīnwǎn děi dǎbāo xíngli.
examples.english: I'm going on a business trip tomorrow, so I have to pack my luggage tonight.

examples.hanzi: 我的同桌叫威利,他很爱笑。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngzhuō jiào Wēilì, tā hěn ài xiào.
examples.english: My desk mate is called Willy, and he loves to laugh.

examples.hanzi: 威利下个月要来中国旅游。
examples.pinyin: Wēilì xià gè yuè yào lái Zhōngguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: Willy is coming to China for a trip next month.

examples.hanzi: 小猫轻轻一跳跃,就上了窗台。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo māo qīngqīng yí tiàoyuè, jiù shàngle chuāngtái.
examples.english: The kitten gave a light leap and got onto the windowsill.

examples.hanzi: 青蛙在荷叶之间跳跃。
examples.pinyin: Qīngwā zài héyè zhījiān tiàoyuè.
examples.english: The frog leaps between the lotus leaves.

examples.hanzi: 昨晚停电了,整个小区都没有电力。
examples.pinyin: Zuówǎn tíngdiàn le, zhěnggè xiǎoqū dōu méiyǒu diànlì.
examples.english: The power went out last night, and the whole neighborhood had no electricity.

examples.hanzi: 这辆车是用电力驱动的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē shì yòng diànlì qūdòng de.
examples.english: This car runs on electric power.

examples.hanzi: 周末在家看书,感觉很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò zài jiā kàn shū, gǎnjué hěn zìzai.
examples.english: Reading at home on weekends feels very relaxed.

examples.hanzi: 在朋友面前,他一点也不自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài péngyou miànqián, tā yìdiǎn yě bú zìzai.
examples.english: He doesn't feel at ease at all in front of his friends.

examples.hanzi: 消防员冒着危险保卫这座城市。
examples.pinyin: Xiāofángyuán màozhe wēixiǎn bǎowèi zhè zuò chéngshì.
examples.english: Firefighters risk danger to defend this city.

examples.hanzi: 我们要保卫地球的环境。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bǎowèi dìqiú de huánjìng.
examples.english: We must protect the Earth's environment.

examples.hanzi: 老师让我们在原地休息一分钟。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen zài yuándì xiūxi yì fēnzhōng.
examples.english: The teacher let us rest on the spot for a minute.

examples.hanzi: 他在原地转了一圈,不知道往哪儿走。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yuándì zhuànle yì quān, bù zhīdào wǎng nǎr zǒu.
examples.english: He turned around in place, not knowing which way to go.

examples.hanzi: 服务生,请给我一杯水。
examples.pinyin: Fúwùshēng, qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ.
examples.english: Waiter, could I have a glass of water, please?

examples.hanzi: 他暑假在餐厅做服务生。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǔjià zài cāntīng zuò fúwùshēng.
examples.english: He works as a waiter at a restaurant during the summer break.

examples.hanzi: 民主需要每个人的参与。
examples.pinyin: Mínzhǔ xūyào měi gè rén de cānyù.
examples.english: Democracy needs everyone's participation.

examples.hanzi: 我们班用投票的民主方式选班长。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān yòng tóupiào de mínzhǔ fāngshì xuǎn bānzhǎng.
examples.english: Our class chooses the class monitor in a democratic way, by voting.

examples.hanzi: 你可以撤销刚才的操作。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ chèxiāo gāngcái de cāozuò.
examples.english: You can undo the action you just did.

examples.hanzi: 公司撤销了对他的处分。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī chèxiāole duì tā de chǔfèn.
examples.english: The company withdrew the disciplinary action against him.

examples.hanzi: 我们住的宾馆离车站很近。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhù de bīnguǎn lí chēzhàn hěn jìn.
examples.english: The hotel we're staying at is very close to the station.

examples.hanzi: 这家宾馆的早餐很丰盛。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā bīnguǎn de zǎocān hěn fēngshèng.
examples.english: This hotel has a very generous breakfast.

examples.hanzi: 说来也巧,我们俩居然是老乡。
examples.pinyin: Shuōlái yě qiǎo, wǒmen liǎ jūrán shì lǎoxiāng.
examples.english: Funnily enough, we turned out to be from the same hometown.

examples.hanzi: 说来惭愧,我到现在还不会游泳。
examples.pinyin: Shuōlái cánkuì, wǒ dào xiànzài hái bú huì yóuyǒng.
examples.english: To be honest, I'm ashamed to say I still can't swim.

examples.hanzi: 别妄想了,天上不会掉馅饼。
examples.pinyin: Bié wàngxiǎng le, tiānshàng bú huì diào xiànbǐng.
examples.english: Stop dreaming; there's no such thing as a free lunch.

examples.hanzi: 他妄想不努力就能考第一。
examples.pinyin: Tā wàngxiǎng bù nǔlì jiù néng kǎo dì yī.
examples.english: He foolishly thinks he can come first without any effort.

examples.hanzi: 今天的事务太多,我得加班。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de shìwù tài duō, wǒ děi jiābān.
examples.english: There's too much to handle today, so I have to work overtime.

examples.hanzi: 他负责处理公司的日常事务。
examples.pinyin: Tā fùzé chǔlǐ gōngsī de rìcháng shìwù.
examples.english: He is in charge of handling the company's daily affairs.

examples.hanzi: 我们给这只小狗命名为“豆豆”。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gěi zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu mìngmíng wéi "Dòudou".
examples.english: We named this puppy "Doudou".

examples.hanzi: 这座桥是以他的名字命名的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo shì yǐ tā de míngzi mìngmíng de.
examples.english: This bridge was named after him.

examples.hanzi: 足球比赛中,防御和进攻一样重要。
examples.pinyin: Zúqiú bǐsài zhōng, fángyù hé jìngōng yíyàng zhòngyào.
examples.english: In soccer, defense is just as important as attack.

examples.hanzi: 他们的防御太弱,很容易被攻破。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen de fángyù tài ruò, hěn róngyì bèi gōngpò.
examples.english: Their defense is too weak and is easily broken through.

examples.hanzi: 请按照路标的指引往前走。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng ànzhào lùbiāo de zhǐyǐn wǎng qián zǒu.
examples.english: Please walk ahead following the signs.

examples.hanzi: 这位老师的指引让我找到了方向。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī de zhǐyǐn ràng wǒ zhǎodàole fāngxiàng.
examples.english: This teacher's guidance helped me find my direction.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在院子里玩得很开心。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài yuànzi lǐ wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: The children are having great fun playing in the yard.

examples.hanzi: 奶奶每天早上都会打扫院子。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai měitiān zǎoshang dōu huì dǎsǎo yuànzi.
examples.english: Grandma sweeps the yard every morning.

examples.hanzi: 洗衣机解放了我们的双手。
examples.pinyin: Xǐyījī jiěfàngle wǒmen de shuāngshǒu.
examples.english: The washing machine has freed our hands.

examples.hanzi: 终于考完试了,我感觉自己被解放了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngyú kǎowán shì le, wǒ gǎnjué zìjǐ bèi jiěfàng le.
examples.english: The exams are finally over, and I feel liberated.

examples.hanzi: 他在法院做司法工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài fǎyuàn zuò sīfǎ gōngzuò.
examples.english: He does judicial work at the court.

examples.hanzi: 这件案子已经交给司法部门处理了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn ànzi yǐjīng jiāogěi sīfǎ bùmén chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: This case has been handed over to the judicial department.

examples.hanzi: 客厅里有一张很大的沙发。
examples.pinyin: Kètīng lǐ yǒu yì zhāng hěn dà de shāfā.
examples.english: There's a very big sofa in the living room.

examples.hanzi: 客人来了,请先请他们到客厅坐。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén lái le, qǐng xiān qǐng tāmen dào kètīng zuò.
examples.english: The guests have arrived; please invite them to sit in the living room first.

examples.hanzi: 他破产以后,真的是一无所有。
examples.pinyin: Tā pòchǎn yǐhòu, zhēn de shì yì wú suǒ yǒu.
examples.english: After going bankrupt, he truly had nothing left.

examples.hanzi: 我们来到这个城市时一无所有。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen láidào zhège chéngshì shí yì wú suǒ yǒu.
examples.english: We had nothing when we came to this city.

examples.hanzi: 我想预定今晚七点的两个座位。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yùdìng jīnwǎn qī diǎn de liǎng gè zuòwèi.
examples.english: I'd like to reserve two seats for seven tonight.

examples.hanzi: 你预定酒店了吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yùdìng jiǔdiàn le ma?
examples.english: Have you booked a hotel?

examples.hanzi: 他在地上跪下,请求大家原谅。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài dìshang guìxià, qǐngqiú dàjiā yuánliàng.
examples.english: He knelt on the ground and begged everyone's forgiveness.

examples.hanzi: 小孩跪下来,捡起地上的玩具。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎohái guì xiàlái, jiǎnqǐ dìshang de wánjù.
examples.english: The child knelt down and picked up the toy on the floor.

examples.hanzi: 爷爷腿不好,需要坐轮椅。
examples.pinyin: Yéye tuǐ bù hǎo, xūyào zuò lúnyǐ.
examples.english: Grandpa's legs are bad, so he needs a wheelchair.

examples.hanzi: 我推着轮椅带奶奶去公园。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tuīzhe lúnyǐ dài nǎinai qù gōngyuán.
examples.english: I pushed the wheelchair to take Grandma to the park.

examples.hanzi: 别这么软弱,要相信自己。
examples.pinyin: Bié zhème ruǎnruò, yào xiāngxìn zìjǐ.
examples.english: Don't be so weak; believe in yourself.

examples.hanzi: 他觉得哭是软弱的表现。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéde kū shì ruǎnruò de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: He thinks crying is a sign of weakness.

examples.hanzi: 别信这个谣言,根本不是真的。
examples.pinyin: Bié xìn zhège yáoyán, gēnběn bú shì zhēn de.
examples.english: Don't believe this rumor; it isn't true at all.

examples.hanzi: 谣言传得很快,一天就人人皆知。
examples.pinyin: Yáoyán chuán de hěn kuài, yì tiān jiù rénrén jiē zhī.
examples.english: Rumors spread fast, and everyone knew within a day.

examples.hanzi: 这个部门来了两位新人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bùmén láile liǎng wèi xīnrén.
examples.english: Two newcomers joined this department.

examples.hanzi: 新人刚上班,有不懂的就问我。
examples.pinyin: Xīnrén gāng shàngbān, yǒu bù dǒng de jiù wèn wǒ.
examples.english: You've just started work, so ask me if you don't understand anything.

examples.hanzi: 这个句子的结构有点复杂。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jùzi de jiégòu yǒudiǎn fùzá.
examples.english: The structure of this sentence is a bit complicated.

examples.hanzi: 你能帮我看看这篇文章的结构吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ kànkan zhè piān wénzhāng de jiégòu ma?
examples.english: Could you look at the structure of this article for me?
